label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 94
title: Model-tier editor: new agents
body:
## Original (as captured)
Dashboard counterpart for the pipeline-phases program.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0120)
Add every new/promoted agent to EVERY profile's agents map in config/model-tier.json (incl. kctier) with role-class model assignment (R/G/C/I) + fallbacks; keep the two model-tier files (config/ + products/ProductForge-Dashboard/) in sync.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).
